title: Alien Shepherd on Cosmic Cliff
description: A surreal black and white artwork depicts a tall alien figure with large eyes standing on a rocky cliff edge, holding a staff topped with a small planet. Below, a small robot-like figure falls upside down into a starry void, while a large circular portal in the sky shows a smiling Saturn-like planet and purple mountains.
prompt: Surreal black and white ink illustration with purple accents, a tall slender alien with big black eyes and geometric patterns on its body stands on a rocky white cliff holding a long staff with a tiny planet on top, a small robot falls upside down into the black starry space below, a large circular portal in the sky reveals a smiling Saturn-like planet with rings and purple mountains inside, decorative geometric symbols and stars float in the black sky, whimsical mysterious atmosphere, detailed linework
